_README: Car capacity in PERSONS, and the BASIS those persons are counted on.
Ships DELIBERATELY EMPTY. Until 'basis' and 'basis_confirmed_by' are filled in, the workbook's
CAR LOADING sheet prints measured peak occupancy in absolute people and WITHHOLDS the loading
factor. That is the intended state, not a broken config: a percentage whose denominator has no
stated basis is not a provisional answer, it is a wrong one that looks finished.
basis_confirmed_by  who confirmed it and from WHICH document (a name alone is not provenance)
sheet_basis      the basis MEP-02 v28's 80% loading assumption is written on. If this differs
from 'basis', the workbook prints its own figure and withholds the comparison:
persons          {cam: whole persons}. PERSONS, never kg — a kg rating divided by an assumed
body mass is a different number with a different error.
